title: Memory Session Flush
description: Use this when you need session memory durably persisted at conversation end and scope promotions reviewed — binds SessionEnd (persists working memory, enqueues episodes, nudges memoryd) and ScopePromotionProposed (runs promotion approval policy). Deterministic; zero LLM calls.
author: sox-ecosystem

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite memory store file used by the flush hook (e.g. ~/.memory/memory.db).

export_enabled.description: When true, a markdown mirror export is automatically triggered after each SessionEnd flush. Default: false (opt-in). Requires export_dir to also be set.

export_dir.description: Directory to write the markdown mirror into on auto-export (e.g. ~/.memory/export). Required when export_enabled=true.

export_throttle_secs.description: Minimum seconds between auto-exports per process lifetime. Prevents redundant re-exports when many sessions end in quick succession. Default: 60s.
